english: Here I go...!
Hyaaah!!
Deyaaa!!
Ah... all spirit, totally no good,\nMiss Valliere.
Nyaa!!
Louise-san, is there any sign\nyour magic trouble is healing?
Yeah... Explosion's no good,\nand as you can see, other magic's no-good-no-good...
How about you, Tiffa?
Me? I'll try.
Ei!
Failed... well, my chest just bounced hard...\nkinda pisses me off...
Her chest itself is magic...
How about it?
No comment...
Tiffa aside, I wonder what's causing\nmy total slump...
Your magic power not recovering at all —\nwhat could that mean?
There's too much we don't know\nabout Void magic.
Hence the secret trip to Romalia,\nthe three of us.
The princess says the Pope of Romalia,\na fellow Void bearer, might know something —\nbut is that true?
If you stay like this, Louise-san,\nit'll be a problem, right?
Yes. The mysterious mage commanding grotesque monsters...\nThey say he wields Void magic too —\nI'm the only one who can oppose him.
Appearing out of nowhere, kidnapping people,\nattacking lands with never-before-seen monsters —\na terrifying mage, right?
But no one's ever seen him...
Unfindable even when every mage\nin the country searches —\nit has to be a Void user.
Yet here I am in a total slump for no reason.\nI have to fix this fast...
Right, let's cut the break short\nand head out!
Ah, Siesta-san, your luggage's spilling.
Ah, oh my?
Get it together.\nSiesta seems perfect, but\nshe's ditzy somewhere in there.
Sorry, Miss Valliere has\nlots of luggage of questionable necessity —\nthere's just so much of it.
What! Got a problem!\nNobles have lots of things, unlike commoners!
Now now, Louise-san, Siesta-san,\ncalm down...
Hm? Ah, what's...?
What's wrong, Tiffa?
The rustling trees... huh!?\nFootsteps? These... aren't beasts!?
What did you say...!
What's wrong?
Siesta, run!
Huh, what is it?
Just run!\nIf you don't want to be surrounded, run!
Ehh, enemies!?
Shishishi...
What are those?\nThere's tons of them!
I don't know.\nSimple muggers, or...!
What should we do?
This wasn't supposed to be a fighting trip —\nwe'll have to escape somehow.
If we're running, that way... let's go!
Yes!
Ow... you...!
Miss Valliere, are you okay?
I'm fine, it's nothing.\nBut to be helpless\nagainst nobodies like these...
If I could just use magic properly...!\nIf only I had my familiar...!!
We did it! If we get this far...!!
Haah... haah... I'm beat...
Hah...!
Tiffa, what's wrong?
No, Louise-san!\nIt's an ambush!!
No!!
Any other escape route?
Where would that be!?
Louise-san... I have an idea.
I'll be the decoy and draw their attention —\nescape in the opening.
What are you saying?\nI can't leave you behind!
At this rate we'll all be done for!\nAt least you and Siesta-san, run!
Tiffa!!
Miss Valliere!\nYou're going the wrong way!
Don't be stupid!\nWe're saving Tiffa!!
No!\nWill you waste Tiffa-san's resolve!?
No! I can't sacrifice Tiffa!
Right now you lack the power\nto save Tiffa-san!\nThat's why we're going to Romalia, isn't it?
You idiot, Siesta!!
...Next time it's my turn to protect you —\nI'm resolved...!!
Siesta...!!
Siesta-san!\nI'm counting on you with Louise-san!!
Tiffaaa!!
Shishishi...
Huh?
What're those!?
How reckless... Nacchan.
Understood, sis...
Shi!?
Huh? Huh?
For now, we're pulling out!
Huh? Ah!?
Tiffa!!
They vanished...!?
Huh!? Now! We run!
But Tiffa!
Tiffa-san isn't here anymore!\nWe can't waste the chance\nshe made for us!
Urgh... okay...
Where might this be?\nDoes anyone know?
A land rich in nature.
Ehehe... it's a calming place♪
Um, this might not be\nthe time to relax...?
What is it?
Huh, those look like... enemies, right?
They look kinda angry...\nDid we interrupt their meal, maybe?
They're clearly\nnot looking to make friends!\nBit sudden, but... shall we just go for it?
W-wah! We just arrived and\nwe're already shooting!?\nIs there really no time...?
...There's zero tension over here,\nbut let's do this!
But of course!\nA star like me is well accustomed\nto schedules planned by the minute!
(Good thing I transformed in advance.)
You're all a little bit lovely, but\nyour attitude is terrible, so I'll just have to\nspoil you with my magical yo-yo!
Guess I'll be the one to settle this~\nNow then, the Magical Magic Show...\nbegins!
Now then, that's taken care of, but\nwhat sort of world is this, I wonder?
Seems like we're quite far\nfrom civilization, no?
Doesn't look like anyone's around, though.\nWhat should we do?
There's a river nearby, so\nI think this would be a perfect campsite.
When I was traveling with [MERU],\nwe'd camp by rivers all the time.\nAnd we'd always end up tumbling in, too.
That might be a good idea.\nThere doesn't seem to be a hotel with showers\nanywhere nearby, after all.
Gasp! This I did not foresee!\nThat I, of all people, cannot take a bath!
Um... this is an outdoor shoot, so...
Well, at least there's water...\nJust imagining this were deep in the mountains\ngives me the shivers.
Tea and bread.\nHere you are, Miss Vallière.
Thank you...
You have to eat at least a little,\nor your body won't hold out.
Yeah... I wonder if Tiffa's all right.
Let's believe she's fine.\nIt's not like the enemy got her.
More importantly, here.\nPlease eat properly.
(What do I do... If we're attacked again,\nthis time it'll be Siesta who...)
(Okay... I've decided!)
I'll have the tea... ow, hot!
I'm sorry!\nDid I make it a little too hot?
What are you doing?!\nGet the tea's temperature right, at least!\nAnd you call yourself a maid?
You're really useless!!
What's wrong?\nThere's no need to get so angry;\ntea cools down quickly.
I burned my tongue!\nThat does it, I'm furious! I can't take this anymore!
From here on, I'm traveling alone,\nso pack your things\nand hurry home!
Huh... Miss Vallière...?
Understood?! You WILL go home!\nAbsolutely! Got it?!
Ah, Miss Vallière!\nWait!
I have to chase her... but\nif I leave the luggage, we can't continue the journey,\nohh, that Louise!!
//After fade to black, scene change\n//BG: city street (day)\n//The Twin Phantom descends, bringing Tiffa along.
Haa... Where... is this?
Surprised?\nTiffania Westwood.
You know my name?\nAh, before that... um, thank you\nfor saving me.
No need for thanks.\nWe're just doing our job.
Your job?
It means we can't have you dying.\nWe originally planned to secure both you and Louise the Zero,\nbut oh well.
Me and Louise?\nWhat do you mean?\nAnd where even is this place...?
Now, now, let's calm down a little.\nHow about some tea?
Y-yes...
...Drink it before it gets cold.
Um, just one thing...\nWho exactly are you two?
We are the Twin Phantom.
Anything beyond that is... unnecessary.
Twin... Phantom...
//END
